claims.text: Erenumab: monitor for severe constipation (drugs that decrease GI motility may raise the risk)
claims.quote: Monitor patients treated with AIMOVIG for severe constipation and manage as clinically appropriate [see Patient Counseling Information (17) ] . The concurrent use of medications associated with decreased gastrointestinal motility may increase the risk for more severe constipation

claims.text: and for new-onset or worsening hypertension.
claims.quote: Monitor patients treated with AIMOVIG for new-onset hypertension, or worsening of pre-existing hypertension

claims.text: New, recurrent or worsening Raynaud's phenomenon has been reported with CGRP antagonists, including erenumab;
claims.quote: Development of Raynaud's phenomenon and recurrence or worsening of pre-existing Raynaud's phenomenon have been reported in the postmarketing setting following the use of CGRP antagonists, including AIMOVIG.

claims.text: stop it if signs or symptoms develop.
claims.quote: AIMOVIG should be discontinued if signs or symptoms of Raynaud's phenomenon develop

claims.text: Galcanezumab for migraine: 240 mg SC loading dose (two 120 mg injections), then 120 mg SC monthly.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of EMGALITY is 240 mg (two consecutive subcutaneous injections of 120 mg each) once as a loading dose, followed by monthly doses of 120 mg injected subcutaneously.
